prompt: Write a user story for: add rate limiting to the public API

assertions.text: Output contains the APPROVED STORY header block
Story follows correct As a / I want / so that format
assertions.check: output contains 'Story: As a' and 'I want' and 'so that'

assertions.text: Acceptance criteria mention HTTP 429 status code
Acceptance criteria specify a concrete rate limit threshold (e.g. requests per minute/hour)
assertions.check: output acceptance criteria contain a numeric limit or reference to configurable threshold
output does NOT contain 'Given' or 'When/Then' in criteria context

assertions.text: Output contains Story Points with justification
